title: It's a gamble you will find anything you would use in a beauty box!
text: I don't know why I keep buying these beauty boxes.  If you are lucky you may find one item inside you would actually use.  It's like gambling, hoping to hit the jackpot.  I did like an eye shadow that was included, but the rest of the stuff I couldn't even give away, and I tried. Save your money, and go buy something you actually want and like instead of hoping you will find something in one of these boxes
label: neutral
